_comment: Three-list registry for the unknown-vendor sweep. The nightly job can only search for senders it knows, so a vendor that is not on a list is INVISIBLE, not merely unhandled. Gmail's own category:purchases classifier does the vendor-agnostic work; this file decides what to do with each hit. Domains match on suffix, so 'ups.com' catches 'mcinfo@ups.com'.

known._comment: Already swept by the itemised-vendor pass. Skip silently — surfacing them here would double-report. Walmart joined 2026-08-24: it is mixed-use like Amazon and eBay, which are also in this list - being swept per-order is what makes per-order classification possible, so 'known' and 'mixed-use' are not exclusive.

suppress._comment: Never surface. Each entry names WHY, because a suppression nobody can audit is how a real order gets silently binned — see the label-stock decline that had to be reversed on 08-21.

carrier.why: Carriers report on someone else's order. The order itself is found from the vendor, and a tracking email would double-count it.

subscription.why: Recurring software/services. Rule 7: memberships and subscriptions are not parts.

food.why: Consumer/household. Rule 2: clearly consumer goes OUT silently.

medical.why: Rule 3: medical/pharmacy/personal-care are OUT and MUST NOT BE TRANSCRIBED. Log the order id only, never the detail. Note wexhealth mail is benefits-card traffic and is not always even Scott's.

payment_rail.why: PayPal/Stripe receipts prove a purchase happened but carry no vendor or line items, so they cannot become a PO. Kept here rather than in triage because the underlying vendor mail is the better source and usually arrives too.

platform._comment: Storefront platforms. The SENDER DOMAIN IS NOT THE VENDOR — 'store+70819512477@t.shopifyemail.com' is MFC Machining & Design Services, and the merchant name only appears in the body. Any classifier keying on domain alone will file every Shopify merchant under one vendor.

merchants._comment: Shopify/storefront store-id -> real merchant name, learned from order bodies. The sender domain is the PLATFORM, never the vendor, so without this map the same merchant is re-surfaced as 'unknown' on every future order. vendor_triage.py does not consume this yet - it is recorded so the name is recoverable and the wiring is a small follow-up.
merchants.70819512477: MFC Machining & Design Services (MFC OFFROAD, Dover NJ) - InvenTree Company #31, promoted 2026-08-24

mixed_use._comment: Sells both shop goods and household goods, like Amazon and eBay already do. Never auto-in; classify per order from the item titles.

lifecycle._comment: Subject prefixes that mark a NON-order stage. 'Shipped'/'Delivered' is not a purchase event; the order confirmation is. Dedupe by order number across the lifecycle so one purchase yields one triage line, not four.
